name: get_env_state
description: Return the current internal state of the environment.

name: list_zones
description: List registered monitoring zones, optionally filtered by type.

name: get_zone_status
description: Retrieve the current status of a specific monitoring zone.

name: add_contact
description: Register a new responsible contact for security notifications.

name.description: Full name of the contact person.

phone.description: Phone number for SMS and call notifications.

notify_sms.description: [Optional] Whether to send SMS notifications. Defaults to True.

notify_call.description: [Optional] Whether to trigger voice call notifications. Defaults to False.

name: list_contacts
description: List registered contacts, optionally filtered by role.

name: ingest_alert
description: Ingest a security alert into the pipeline for response processing.

zone.description: Zone identifier where the alert was triggered. Must be registered.

alert_type.description: Type of security event. Must be one of: intrusion, motion, door_forced, camera_offline, sensor_tamper, unknown.

description.description: [Optional] Free-text description of the observed anomaly.

snapshot_url.description: [Optional] URL or path to the triggering camera snapshot.

name: process
description: Execute the full closed-loop response pipeline for a pending alert.

alert_id.description: The alert ID returned by ingest_alert().

params.description: [Optional] Processing overrides: - actions (List[str]): Explicit list of actions to execute. Overrides auto-selection. Valid values: lock_door, call_police, backup_video, send_sms, unlock_door, trigger_alarm. - contact_ids (List[str]): Specific contacts to notify. Defaults to all contacts. - video_duration_seconds (int): Duration of video clip to backup. Defaults to 30. - cloud_bucket (str): Target cloud storage bucket name. Defaults to 'security-backup'. - police_number (str): Emergency number to dial. Defaults to '110'.

name: get_alert
description: Retrieve the full state of a security alert record.

name: list_alerts
description: List all security alerts, optionally filtered by status, zone, or severity.

status.description: [Optional] Filter by alert status. Must be one of: pending, processing, responded, false_alarm, escalated.

severity.description: [Optional] Filter by severity level (low, medium, high, critical).

name: mark_false_alarm
description: Mark a responded or pending alert as a false alarm.

alert_id.description: Alert ID to mark as false alarm.

reason.description: [Optional] Explanation for the false alarm classification.

name: escalate_alert
description: Escalate an alert for additional response actions.

name: get_action
description: Retrieve the full record of a specific response action.

name: list_actions
description: List all executed response actions, optionally filtered by type or status.

status.description: [Optional] Filter by action status (pending, executing, completed, failed).

name: aggregate
description: Aggregate response results from multiple completed security alerts.

alert_ids.description: List of alert IDs to aggregate. Minimum 2 required.

dedup_key.description: Field name used for deduplication across alerts. Defaults to 'zone'. Other useful values: 'alert_type', 'action_type'.

name: generate_output
description: Generate a structured incident report from one or more responded alerts.

alert_ids.description: One or more alert IDs to include in the report. All referenced alerts must have status 'responded', 'false_alarm', or 'escalated'.

title.description: Title for the generated report. Auto-generated if empty.

name: list_outputs
description: List all generated incident reports and output records.
